name: Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Set the seat so the handles are near shoulder height and sit with both feet planted.
Rest your back against the pad and grasp the handles with your wrists stacked over your elbows.
Press the handles smoothly overhead until your arms are extended without forcefully locking your elbows.
Lower the handles slowly back down to shoulder level without letting the weight stack touch down.
tips: Keep your lower back and head resting comfortably against the backrest rather than arching sharply.
Let your shoulder blades rotate naturally as the handles rise.
